title: The Night Connection
transcript: The last bus serving a hospital district usually left with empty seats, yet cleaners finishing the late shift often paid for a taxi home. When the transport office compared bus times with staff schedules, it found that the last bus pulled away just before the cleaners could reach the stop. For a trial, the office delayed that departure and moved the stop from the main entrance to the staff gate. Use of the last bus rose, but some workers still took taxis. Interviews revealed that their connecting bus at the central station was already gone by the time they arrived. The next timetable therefore gives the two routes a shared departure window at the station. Planners will count completed journeys as well as boardings near the hospital.

questions.prompt: Why did cleaners often miss the original last bus?
options: The bus filled up before reaching the hospital.
The main entrance closed before their shift ended.
The route skipped the hospital on busy nights.
The bus left before they could reach the stop.
questions.answer: The bus left before they could reach the stop.
questions.explanation: 清洁工下班后还没赶到站点，末班车就已经开走了。

questions.prompt: Why will planners count completed journeys?
options: To work out how often the hospital changes its shift times
To estimate the number of seats needed near the hospital
To see whether passengers can get all the way to their destinations by bus
To determine which entrance most hospital workers use
questions.answer: To see whether passengers can get all the way to their destinations by bus
questions.explanation: 医院站的上车人数无法反映后续换乘是否成功，完整行程能检验两条线路的衔接效果。
